settings.about_text:
Platsky represents quality manufacturers who offer a complete range of products from breaking ground, roughing, finishing to final fixtures. In the eighty years we’ve been in business Platsky has established personal relationships with wholesalers, contractors, builders, engineers, architects and code officials. This multi-level approach allows our team to be involved in the entire lifespan of projects from specification to start-ups and final inspections. Being involved throughout the building process has allowed Platsky to continually grow mature brands, as well as, successfully introduce new products to the market.

Education is a key foundation of our philosophy. We aggressively promote continuing education by offering professional training opportunities in our live fire training center. We also take training to the industry by utilizing our mobile training center at counters, offices, jobsites and offsite training centers.

Platsky continues to look ahead and makes decisions with an eye on the future. Over the past decade we have added engineering, heating, quoting and marketing departments. We have also added personnel to focus on plumbing contractors, mechanical contractors, plumbing engineers, mechanical engineers and architectural designers. Platsky’s management team has a balance of youth and experience that positions us well for decades to come.
